objective.title: OAES v2: frozen specification, reference runtime, and continuation contract
objective.description: Evolve this repository into the implementation-ready OAES v2 standard while preserving the complete OAES v1 (Foundation 1.0-1.2) lineage: frozen five-concept Kernel, canonical data model, deterministic reference runtime, persistent machine-readable project state, and cross-session continuation.

success_criteria.description: The frozen OAES v2 specification (spec/) is complete and passes the documentation consistency scan.
The deterministic reference runtime passes typecheck, all tests (including kernel/state invariant guards and interruption/resumption), and the synthetic demo.
Any future Actor can continue solely from repository files: BOOTSTRAP.md, adapters, CURRENT_STATE.md, HANDOFF.md, and runtime-state/project.json exist and agree.
Release validation: all checks pass, README/CHANGELOG present v2 as current with v1 preserved, the branch is pushed and aligned with the remote, and the v2.0.0 tag exists.

knowledge.content: The frozen OAES v2 specification lives in spec/ (KERNEL, CANONICAL_DATA_MODEL, STATE_MODEL, RUNTIME, VOCABULARY) with decision records OAES-DEC-011..017. Verification criteria: the documentation consistency scan (npm run check:docs) passes.

The deterministic reference runtime lives in reference-runtime/ with schemas in schemas/. Verification criteria: npm run typecheck, npm test (47 tests incl. invariant guards and resumption), and npm run demo all pass.

Cross-session continuation is carried by BOOTSTRAP.md (canonical protocol), CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md (thin adapters), CURRENT_STATE.md and HANDOFF.md (human-readable projections), and runtime-state/project.json (machine-readable authority). Verification criteria: the consistency scan's adapter and link checks pass.

Final release validation for OAES v2.0.0: full check:all run, README/INDEX/CHANGELOG authority update, security scan, push verification, and the v2.0.0 tag. Verification criteria: all commands pass and the remote tag exists.
